name: Mikuriya Ai
source:
Ai is 2-B's Class Representative, who's very shy, kind and sensible. She is a good friend of [url=/c11297]Koume[/url], and they always cooperate with each other. Ai tends to stay behind her when she senses any troubles. Nevertheless, she seems to be the only person who can control Koume's extreme temperament.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maple_Colors_2]Wikipedia[/url] and roughly translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=559385]Getchu[/url].]
